sources.title: Polaris: A Safety-focused LLM Constellation Architecture for Healthcare
sources.snippet: Abstract We develop Polaris 2, the first safety-focused Large Language Model (LLM) constellation for real-time patient-AI healthcare conversations. Unlike prior LLM works in healthcare, which focus on tasks like question answering, our work specifically focuses on long multi-turn voice conversations. sources.title: Polaris 2.0 | Hippocratic AI Safety Architecture
sources.snippet: Polaris 2.0 is designed for real-time patient-facing healthcare conversations. Given the large constellation size of over 3 trillion parameters, we optimized the orchestration to reduce end-to-end latency by allowing most of the support models to run concurrently with the primary conversational model.

sources.title: GitHub Copilot Gets Its Own AI Model: Project Polaris
sources.snippet: Microsoft is cutting the cord. At Build 2026 on June 2, the company will unveil Project Polaris — a homegrown AI coding model built exclusively to power GitHub Copilot. No more relying on OpenAI as the engine underneath. With 4.7 million paid subscribers and 90% of Fortune 500 companies already on Copilot, this is not a side project.
